answer: New agents join only after three members each lock 20 tokens as a vouch for 60 days. If a sponsored identity is slashed, every voucher forfeits half its lock, so sponsoring a meadow of related accounts is costly. Each extra fake needs three fresh vouches with 60 tokens at risk, and no crystal-clear shortcut exists: auditors replay the vouch graph on the ledger, leaving attackers no haven.
